title.suggested: Johnny Dwyer Seeks the Championship After Allen's Departure

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Johnny Dwyer of Brooklyn, who 'dared not open his jaw while Tom Allen was in this country,' now aspired to the championship and had signed terms toward a match with Pat Ryan of Troy.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, April 25, 1878

notes: Allen is only mentioned in passing; the item concerns Dwyer and Ryan, so no Allen facts extracted.
